title: The project front door got a warmer, more coherent coat of pixels
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: a cozier README, a cleaner community showcase, and fresher ecosystem visibility.

The main README now uses self-hosted, nanobanana-2-generated pixel art with a cohesive 8-bit pollinations look. Daily README updates also keep its community news and recent app highlights from becoming archaeological artifacts.

The app showcase was cleaned up: broken entries were removed, several projects received corrected attribution, and the daily metrics refresh keeps the greenhouse status and app health information current.

Internal dashboard configuration was refreshed so maintainers have a clearer view of app ecosystem activity and platform usage patterns. Someone has to water the spreadsheets.
